title: Paul's ascent to the third heaven

tellings.quote: Some scholars even believe that the Apostle Paul may have been familiar with these practices and he described his own celestial ascent to the third heaven in the second Corinthians

plain: The Apostle Paul, the early Christian leader, is said to have described his own rise into the heavens, to what he called the third heaven. Michels tells this himself, citing Paul's letter known as Second Corinthians in the Bible, and says some scholars think Paul knew of ancient practices of journeying up to the heavens. If true, it would mean such mystical journeys were part of Christianity from its very beginning.
